name: Pemmican
desc: Dried meat pounded with fat into a brick, the polar explorers' favourite since the first expeditions: all the calories, none of the charm. Restores 120 HP, and sticks to your teeth until spring.

name: Midwinter Dinner
desc: Every Antarctic base holds a feast on Midwinter's Day, 21 June. Roast, pudding and a speech from the base commander. Nobody has ever left hungry, or sober. Restores 220 HP.

name: Fid's Woolly Hat
desc: A heavy knitted hat in the style of the old Falkland Islands Dependencies Survey men: warm enough for a winter on the Peninsula and daft enough for the photographs. Handed down, like the beards.
msg: {name}'s Woolly Hat kept the frost off!

name: Mail Sack
desc: A heavy canvas sack of postcards, due for the Penguin Post Office at Port Lockroy. It smells of aviation fuel and good intentions.
